items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Rainey played it all by himself. But then, you see, he had a piano player, Walter Daniel.

ctx.x: What about dancing? Yeah, dancing too.
Rainey played it all by himself. But then, you see, he had a piano player, Walter Daniel. Mm-hmm. When he took down the piano, did the solo work.
I must have just missed you, because when I came to the Cadillac, they had a white band there. I didn't stay to listen.
